information: **FRIDAY WILL TAKE PLACE IN A DIFFERENT LOCATION THAN SATURDAY AND SUNDAY. PLEASE SEE THE *TRAVEL* TAB FOR MORE INFORMATION** ![GLC 2023 logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1EyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f3164e8def90c1f1c43b87294a7487963457116f/image.png) ![Partnered organizations logos](https://i.imgur.com/ghYzBXw.png) This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2023. The following states are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion: Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio and Wisconsin. This competition will also feature several Extra Events on Friday after the Staff Competition. If you are interested in competing in these events, please see the [Extra Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023#27312-extra-events) tab for more information On Saturday, we will also feature a special [States Relay](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023#27310-states-relay) event, where teams from the Great Lakes states will face off head-to-head to crown the States Relay champions. [CubingUSA Great Lakes FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesFMCChampionship2023) will take place in multiple locations on October 14th, 2023.
